object.description: Setup: notification permission granted. Steps: 1. Start a session and lock the phone. 2. Read the notification elapsed time and the Active screen elapsed time. 3. Use its Pause action, then its Resume action, then its Finish action; check the session state after each. Expected: The notification elapsed time is within 2 s of the Active screen; Pause is offered while recording and changes the state to paused; Resume is offered while paused and changes the state to recording; Finish ends the session.
